business_problem: Aldecis needed to automate bottom-up financial analysis because CFO and FP&A teams were spending days hunting through dashboards to find the operational causes of margin and profit drift.
solution_summary: Aldecis uses BigQuery, BigQuery ML, Gemini, and Cloud Run to support P&L drift detection and financial anomaly analysis. Aldecis needed to automate bottom-up financial analysis because CFO and FP&A teams were spending days hunting through dashboards to find the operational causes of margin and profit drift. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in BigQuery, governs access and lineage with Google Cloud Identity and Access Management, coordinates repeatable workflows with Cloud Run, and runs transformation or AI logic on BigQuery ML. Streaming operational telemetry and business events are consolidated into BigQuery; pipeline execution is coordinated with Cloud Run; BigQuery ML applies analytics or model logic.
